prompt: What is the purpose of DANE?
choices: Verify the integrity of name information retrieved via DNS
Provide a way to verify the association of X.509 certificates to DNS host names
Invalidate cached name information to speed up updates
Discover which servers offer a specific service within a DNS domain
explanation: DANE (DNS-based Authentication of Named Entities) binds TLS certificates to DNS names via TLSA records secured by DNSSEC.
